description: Fork of exp670 (1.4569 @ 86.5M, nh=4 out_proj). Add read_out with exp611's exact settings: nh=1, NAP=5, tph=1536, n_outputs=384 (monolithic, K=32, 6x more tables than exp666's read_out). read_out per-module: 1*1536*32*384 = 18,874,368 = 18.87M (3x bigger than exp666's read_out 6.29M). Total: 86.5M + 18.87M = ~105.4M (slightly above 100M). Tests whether exp611's monolithic NAP=5 read_out shape (the version that produced 1.4047 in exp611) transplants the read_out's contribution cleanly onto exp670's nh=4 base. References: exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (current <100M SOTA, smaller read_out nh=6 NAP=6 tph=256), exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M (exp611 with this exact read_out + bigger qk/v/out_proj), exp670 = 1.4569 @ 86.5M (no read_out), exp677 = 1.4577 @ 92.8M (read_out nh=4 NAP=6 tph=256).
